<description>
Part of the effort discussed in #35994: replace procedural, field-by-field construction of `COutPoint`, `CTxIn` and `CTxOut` in test code with constructor calls.

This change is test-only, and has no behaviour change. Any change to the constructed transactions would be caught by the hash and signature checks in `script_tests` and `transaction_tests`.

*Notes for reviewers: In `BuildSpendingTransaction`, the `scriptWitness` assignment is deliberately moved after `vin` is replaced, since `CTxIn` has no witness constructor argument.*
</description>

<commits>
66f6236992 test: construct transaction_utils inputs/outputs declaratively

Replace resize() followed by per-field assignments to COutPoint, CTxIn
and CTxOut with constructor calls in an initializer list.

In BuildSpendingTransaction, the scriptWitness assignment moves after
vin is replaced, since CTxIn has no witness constructor argument and
assigning it first would discard it.

No behavior change.
</commits>
